defects.observed: Card 1 icon: the question mark inside the magnifying glass is malformed/inverted. The SVG draws the dot (line x1=11 y1=8 x2=11 y2=8.5) ABOVE the curve (path at y~9.5) and the stem (line 11,12 -> 11,13.5) below it. At 36px it renders as a hook with a floating dot on top and a detached dash beneath - it does not read as a '?'.
defects.required: Rubric 6: SVG must render correctly, no broken shapes, no stray artifacts. Icon semantics must match the failure content ('No Market Need').

defects.observed: Card 3 icon ('Wrong Team'): the X cross (lines 18,3.5-21,6.5 and 21,3.5-18,6.5) sits directly on top of the second person's head circle (cx=17.5 cy=9 r=2.3, top edge y=6.7) with only 0.2 user units of clearance. At the rendered 36px size the stroked X and the head merge into a single unreadable red knot, and the second figure's torso is a detached floating arc. Shapes overlap and read as broken.
defects.required: Rubric 3/6: no overlapping elements; SVG renders correctly with no broken shapes.

defects.observed: Card 4 icon ('Poor Product') crams three unrelated glyphs into one 24x24 box: a star, a small X, and a right-pointing arrowhead. The X and arrow render as stray disconnected artifacts at the bottom of the icon and convey no coherent meaning for 'Poor Product'.
defects.required: Rubric 6: no stray artifacts; icon semantics must match the reason it labels.

defects.observed: Card 2 icon ('Running Out of Cash') is a generic briefcase/case with a horizontal band and a small dot - it carries no money, currency, declining-trend, or emptying semantics. It reads as 'work/portfolio', not 'running out of cash'.
defects.required: Icon semantics must match the failure content.

defects.observed: Each grid card is ~248px tall but the icon + heading + one sentence occupy only the top ~110px, leaving roughly half of every card as empty white space below the text (visible as large blank lower halves in all four cards). The 2x2 grid looks unbalanced and unfinished.
defects.required: Rubric 2/4: layout should present the 2x2 grid as a deliberate, balanced arrangement for a presentation slide.

defects.observed: Footer slide number '7' is set at font-size:18px, below the >= ~20px presentation body-text guidance (it is the smallest text on the slide and the only text under 20px). Contrast measured at 5.75:1 (#5a6478 on #fafbfc) does pass WCAG AA for normal text.
defects.required: Rubric 4: reasonable font sizes for a presentation, body >= ~20px equivalent.

summary: All literal requirements are met: title 'Why Startups Fail', exactly 4 reason cards in a true 2x2 CSS grid, each with an inline SVG icon, a 26px bold heading and one 20px supporting sentence, plus a footer containing only '7' (no unrequested footer text). No overflow (scrollW/H = 1280x720), no console errors, and t0/t2/t5 are byte-identical as expected for a static slide. All text passes WCAG AA: headings/title #1a2035 on #ffffff (~15:1), body #3f4757 on #ffffff (9.3:1), footer #5a6478 on #fafbfc (5.75:1). Defects are concentrated in the SVG icons: the 'No Market Need' question mark is drawn upside down (dot above the curve, stem below), the 'Wrong Team' X collides with and merges into the second figure's head at render size while its torso floats detached, the 'Poor Product' icon is a star plus stray X and arrowhead artifacts with muddled semantics, and the 'Running Out of Cash' briefcase carries no cash/decline meaning. Layout-wise, roughly half of every card is empty space below the text, and the footer is the only sub-20px text on the slide.
